items.text: Eagles situation includes Jalen Hurts OUT (corroborated); first game without him, Tanner McKee to start.
items.implication: McKee starts with top-4 pass-catchers healthy per Levitan; Saquon also OUT.
items.opportunity: Elevated targets/routes for DeVonta Smith, Goedert, Wicks with backup QB.

items.text: Saquon Barkley listed OUT for Sunday along with Jalen Hurts and Will Shipley. ETR Sunday injury roundup confirms the Eagles backfield and QB situation.
items.why: ETR comprehensive Sunday injury list; corroborated by Schefter ruling.
items.implication: Major downgrade to Eagles RB production; backup/4th-string Dameon Pierce likely sees work; pass-catchers with McKee.
items.opportunity: Handcuff/backup RB snaps and possible receiving work in PHI backfield; healthy top pass-catchers (DeVonta etc.) with backup QB.

items.text: Ravens ruled out Lamar Jackson for Sunday’s game at Cleveland due to ankle injury. Huntley expected to start again.
items.why: Official ruling after missing all practice; second straight week.
items.implication: Tyler Huntley starts; Ravens pass game and rushing efficiency change; Flowers/Andrews usage shifts.
items.opportunity: Increased opportunity for Huntley-led offense skill players; check Zay Flowers and TE targets.

items.text: Unclear on Qs AJ Brown (ankle), TreVeyon Henderson (ankle), DJ Moore (shoulder). Tyler Warren (groin) Friday Q add. Probable-leaning: Caleb Williams, DK Metcalf, Chris Olave, Rico Dowdle. PIT thin at WR expecting 2-WR with Metcalf/Bernard. PHI McKee has top-4 pass-catchers (DeVonta/Goedert/Wicks/Lemon) but 4th-string RB.
items.why: Player-specific read on practice/Q tags and role implications from ETR list.
items.implication: Monitor Brown/Henderson closely; lean start on probable Qs; Metcalf volume bump if thin WR room; PHI pass game viable.
items.opportunity: Potential full roles for probable Qs; Metcalf routes up; PHI WR/TE targets concentrated.

items.text: Ladd McConkey and Quentin Johnston listed IN; Schefter notes McConkey has no injury designation.
items.implication: Full expected role in LAC offense vs KC; Chargers have other outs on OL/DL.
items.opportunity: Normal routes/targets for McConkey as lead WR.

items.text: DeVonta Smith listed IN; returns healthy among top PHI pass-catchers with McKee starting and Saquon/Hurts OUT.
items.why: ETR IN clearance; Levitan notes top-4 pass-catchers healthy.
items.implication: Primary target for McKee; solid WR2 upside in void of Hurts/Barkley.
items.opportunity: High target share, routes with backup QB and thin RB room.

items.text: Cardinals ruled out RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) for Sunday vs Rams; resting for long-term healing.
items.why: Official out; coach notes rest for healing.
items.implication: ARI RB committee or next man up for carries vs LAR.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/carries for other Cardinals RBs.

items.text: Jets once again ruled out RB Breece Hall (quad) and WR AD Mitchell for Sunday vs Patriots.
items.implication: Jets RB work to backups; receiving void if Mitchell also out.

items.text: LOVE Rhamondre Stevenson vs NYJ as RB9; volume with Henderson trending out (ankle Q), prior full-game usage strong (19% targets, 23 rushes).
items.why: Potential feature back if Henderson sits; good matchup volume.
items.implication: Strong RB2/flex with upside if clear lead.
items.opportunity: Expanded carries/targets if Henderson OUT/Q inactive.
items.conflict: Henderson still Q per ETR/Levitan; unclear.

items.text: CeeDee Lamb, Ashton Jeanty, Michael Penix listed IN (Penix no designation, will start).
items.why: ETR IN section; NFL.com confirms Penix clear.
items.implication: Full expected usage for Lamb and Jeanty; Penix under center for ATL.

items.text: LOVE Mike Evans vs WSH as WR4; Commanders defense buffet for pass catchers.
items.why: Matchup vs weak WSH secondary; high ranking.
items.implication: Strong start/WR1-2 upside in favorable spot.
items.opportunity: High target/route volume expected in good matchup.

items.text: LOVE Drake London vs CHI as WR6; bankable usage.
LOVE Kyren Williams vs ARI as RB5; elite recent usage and leaky run D.
items.why: Volume + matchup vs ARI run defense.

items.text: HATE Jaylen Waddle vs SEA as WR28; ugly matchup and QB situation.
items.why: Tough SEA defense + shaky QB play limiting production.
